components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);font:700 14px/1.2 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input{height:48px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--edge,#8f8f8a);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface,#f4f2ef);color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);font:400 16px/1 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent,#887748);outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#887748) 20%,transparent);outline-offset:0}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A ruled choice group with a graphite inverse selection.
components.css: .ds-segmented{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface,#f4f2ef)}.ds-segmented button{height:44px;border:0;border-right:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4);border-radius:2px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font:700 13px/1 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-segmented button:last-child{border-right:0}.ds-segmented button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);color:var(--ground,#eae9e8)}.ds-segmented button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#887748);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Date Index
components.description: A horizontally scrollable measured date strip.
components.css: .ds-date-index{display:flex;overflow:auto;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink,#0b0b0b)}.ds-date-index button{min-width:72px;height:48px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4);background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font:700 15px/1 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-date-index button:last-child{border-right:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4)}.ds-date-index button:hover{background:var(--wash,#e2e0dc)}.ds-date-index button[aria-current=date]{background:var(--accent,#887748);color:var(--on-accent,#fff)}.ds-date-index button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#887748);outline-offset:-3px}

components.name: Mode Navigation
components.description: The rectilinear four-mode anchor at the bottom of a plan.

components.name: Schedule Row
components.description: The unboxed ordinary activity row aligned to the time rail.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-schedule-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 44px;align-items:start;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4);color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b)}.ds-schedule-row time{padding-top:4px;font:700 13px/1.2 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-schedule-row div{display:grid;gap:3px;padding:4px 8px}.ds-schedule-row small{color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font:700 9px/1 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em}.ds-schedule-row strong{font:700 24px/1.05 Finlandica,Arial Narrow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-schedule-row span{color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font:400 13px/1.3 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-schedule-row button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent}.ds-schedule-row i{width:24px;height:24px;border:1px solid var(--ring,#696a66);border-radius:2px}.ds-schedule-row button:hover{background:var(--wash,#e2e0dc)}.ds-schedule-row button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#887748);outline-offset:0}

components.name: Flight Ticket
components.description: The flight-only boarding-pass exception with factual route and timing data.
components.css: .ds-flight-ticket{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--edge,#8f8f8a);background:var(--surface,#f4f2ef);color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);font-family:Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-flight-ticket>b{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:36px;background:var(--accent,#887748)}.ds-flight-ticket header{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px 8px 48px;color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em}.ds-flight-ticket header span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em}.ds-flight-ticket section{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px 12px 48px;border-block:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4)}.ds-flight-ticket section>strong{font:700 38px/1 Finlandica,Arial Narrow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ds-flight-ticket section small{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font:400 10px/1.2 Lato,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-flight-ticket section i{color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font-style:normal;font-size:24px}.ds-flight-ticket footer{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;padding:12px 16px 12px 48px;border-top:1px dashed var(--edge,#8f8f8a);color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em}.ds-flight-ticket footer strong{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-flight-ticket:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#887748);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-sheet{display:flex;max-height:92vh;max-width:576px;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4);border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;background:var(--ground,#eae9e8);color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgb(11 11 11/.18);font-family:Lato,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-sheet header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:20px 24px 8px}.ds-sheet h2{margin:0;font:600 28px/1 Finlandica,Arial Narrow,sans-serif}.ds-sheet header button{width:44px;height:44px;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#5c5c59);font-size:24px}.ds-sheet>div{padding:12px 24px 20px}.ds-sheet footer{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:12px 24px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#aaa9a4)}.ds-sheet footer button{height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--edge,#8f8f8a);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface,#f4f2ef);color:var(--ink,#0b0b0b);font-weight:700}.ds-sheet footer button:last-child{border-color:var(--accent,#887748);background:var(--accent,#887748);color:var(--on-accent,#fff)}.ds-sheet button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#887748);outline-offset:2px}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-sheet{border-radius:8px}}

narrative.overview:
Plan A is a measured architectural schedule, not a stack of soft lifestyle cards. Its defining move is a continuous itinerary grid whose precision makes complex days feel composed: a compact trip header, a measured date index, a fixed time rail, and calm chronological rows that preserve the shape of the day.

The visual world is limestone, graphite, zinc, and aged brass. Finlandica supplies condensed editorial authority; Lato handles instructions and dense operational detail. Space, rules, and alignment create hierarchy. Flights alone may expand into boarding-pass modules because that topology improves travel scanning; nothing else borrows airport costume.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous ruled schedules instead of floating activity cards.
Rectilinear 0–6px geometry for ordinary interface elements.
Finlandica headlines and titles paired with compact Lato notation.
Aged brass reserved for selection, completion, primary action, and flight indexing.
Light and dark themes that preserve identical hierarchy and interaction semantics.
Information-dense flight tickets inside an otherwise unboxed itinerary.

rules.name: The Scarce Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass communicates action, selection, completion, or flight indexing. Do not spend it on decoration or ordinary body copy.

rules.name: The Semantic Parity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes values, never roles: every light token has the same purpose and hierarchy at night.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Finlandica names and summarizes; Lato explains and operates. Do not set long instructions or dense form copy in Finlandica.

rules.name: The Continuous Grid Rule
rules.body: New itinerary content must align to the existing time rail and rules; do not introduce a floating card merely to group ordinary activity data.

rules.name: The Rules-Before-Shadows Rule
rules.body: If a border, tonal change, or spacing break can express the hierarchy, use it. Shadows mean that a surface is temporarily above the page.

rules.name: The Rectilinear Default Rule
rules.body: Every new control or container starts at 0–4px and may reach 6px only when its scale needs it.

rules.name: The Ticket Exception Rule
rules.body: Perforations, cut-outs, airport-code typography, and indexed colour strips belong only to flight entries.

dos: Do preserve the continuous time rail and chronological rules when adding itinerary data.
Do use Finlandica for titles, airport codes, and summary numbers while keeping operational copy in Lato.
Do keep brass scarce and semantic: action, selection, completion, focus, and flight indexing.
Do maintain role-for-role parity across light and dark themes.
Do expose local departure and arrival context for flights without losing the larger day.
Do retain 44px minimum targets, visible keyboard focus, semantic pressed/current states, modal focus handling, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't turn ordinary activities, gaps, or form groups into soft lifestyle cards.
Don't use pill geometry for containers or controls; Tailwind radius aliases must continue to resolve to the architectural 4–6px scale.
Don't apply boarding-pass styling, perforations, airport codes, or ticket cut-outs to anything except a flight.
Don't invent live flight facts such as gates, terminals, delays, or status.
Don't add shadows to resting content or introduce decorative gradients, photography, or illustration.
Don't let a desktop viewport turn the plan into a multi-panel dashboard; one mode remains the one job on screen.
